summary.en: WispTerm through Magpie: select models and restore settings on disconnect. Requires a compatible app build and one-time config directory setup.
summary.zh: 通过 Magpie 为 WispTerm 选择模型，断开恢复配置。需要兼容的主程序版本，首次使用须初始化接入目录。
